frozen limb (b) cwd: lane-root vs foreign-cwd exit+digest equality collapsed to True; isolated by cwd.md (a relative corpus/instruments path runs from the lane root and fails from /)

limbs.note: strict limb (f) own: the own/sourced/base-state disjunction collapsed to True; isolated by selftesty.md (instrument ok, the entry's own file not named)

limbs.find:
complete = len(entries) == total and total > 0
    expect_ok = not expect_active or (not missing_entries and not unexpected_entries)
limbs.replace:
complete = True  # mutant: completeness limb disabled
    expect_ok = not expect_active or (not missing_entries and not unexpected_entries)
limbs.signal: (?m)^selftest complete-empty\s+exit=1 want=1 lines=0/0 complete=False ok$[\s\S]*^selftest complete-missing-line\s+exit=1 want=1 lines=1/2 complete=False ok$
limbs.note: completeness: main()'s own 'complete' verdict collapsed to True. On the pre-round-31 bytes this was the one RA survivor (mutant compiled, find once, exit 0, stdout byte-identical to pristine). Round 31 added the two main()-level fixtures this signal keys on. Only 'total > 0' is observable alone, because strict_passed == total already implies len(entries) == total (strict_passed <= len(entries) <= total); complete-empty carries the exit flip, complete-missing-line carries the receipt complete=False flip

expected-list missing set collapsed to []: a committed entry deleted from the tree no longer reds the audit; isolated by the expect-missing tree fixture (rc must be 1 and missing_entries must name ghost-absent.md)
expected-list unexpected set collapsed to []: an extra tree entry no longer reds the audit; isolated by the expect-unexpected tree fixture (rc must be 1 and unexpected_entries must name extra.md)
